articles.summary: Conference Call to be Held at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on November 4, 2026 Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (“Pursuit” or the “company”) (NYSE: PRSU), announced today that it plans to release financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 after market close on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 and will host a conference call at 5 p.m. Eastern Time on the same day to review its financial results and provide business updates. A live audio webcast of the call will be available in listen-only mode through the "Events Presentations" section of Pursuit’s website, where the company will also post its earnings press release and an earnings presentation prior to the call. The live call can also be accessed by dialing (833) 461-5787 and entering the access code 242 289 230. To avoid wait time and bypass speaking with an operator to join the call, participants can pre-register using the following registration link: https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/242289230?pwd=cMDIz1t5 . articles.summary: Aerial tramway would create a one-of-a-kind year-round mountain sightseeing experience offering accessible and iconic views of Glacier National Park and the surrounding Flathead Valley Pursuit Attractions and Hospitality, Inc. (NYSE: PRSU) today announced that it has submitted a proposal to the U.S. Forest Service for a Special Use Permit for the development and operation of the Glacier View Tram, a sightseeing aerial tramway on the north slopes of Columbia Mountain in the Flathead National Forest near Hungry Horse, Montana and Glacier National Park. A conceptual rendering of the proposed Glacier View Tram. Design details are subject to change. The Glacier View Tram is being proposed as a year-round mountain sightseeing experience designed to connect people with the landscape, including visitors who cannot safely or practically reach higher elevations on foot. articles.title: Pursuit Submits Proposal to Develop Sightseeing Tram Near Glacier National Park
